claim: The Reproducibility Project: Cancer Biology is a collaboration between the Center for Open Science and Science Exchange that seeks to address concerns about reproducibility in scientific research by conducting replications of selected experiments from high-profile papers in cancer biology.

claim: In 2012, Willingham et al. reported that blocking the SIRPα/CD47 interaction with an anti-CD47 blocking antibody promoted phagocytosis of solid tumor cells in vitro.
